item.text: I’ll build a single-page explorer with 24 sample endpoints and live controls for method, path, p95 sort order, and the slow threshold.

Built the [latency explorer](/private/var/folders/j2/0l767d9j63qcv0rxzl_1zvrc0000gn/T/tmp.vuZ4qFIKLP/index.html) with 24 sample endpoints, HTTP method filtering, path search, p95 sorting, and slow-endpoint highlighting above an adjustable threshold that defaults to 350 ms.
